# Juan (John) Tubert

> Chief Technology Officer at Tombras. Juan (also known as John) Tubert works
> across creative technology, media and AI. This site is a running record of
> his talks, interviews, awards, published articles and work.

jtubert.com is a single AMP Web Story. All 52 entries live in the HTML of the
one page at https://www.jtubert.com/ — there are no separate URLs per entry.

## Facts

- Name: Juan Tubert. Also written as John Tubert or Juan (John) Tubert.
- Role: Chief Technology Officer at Tombras (https://www.tombras.com/).
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jtubert/
- Entries span 2017 to the present.

## What the entries cover

Each entry carries a category, a headline, a date and usually a link to the
source. Categories in use: Article, Speaker, Work, Interview, Award, Panelist,
Judge, AI Test, Certification, Book, Video, Quote, Game, Podcast.
